Act5-2#1.zh: 众人来到东京，正待进酒铺歇脚，街头却横过四个泼皮，拦住了去路。
Act5-2#1.t: The group arrived in Kaifeng. Just as they were about to rest in a wine shop, four street thugs cut across and blocked their way.

Act5-2#2.zh: 和尚，打俺们地面经过，怎地不留下些买酒钱？
Act5-2#2.t: Monk, you're passing through our turf. Aren't you going to leave us some drinking money?

Act5-2#3.zh: 洒家不曾吃你的酒，倒来问洒家讨钱？
Act5-2#3.t: I haven't drunk any of your wine, and you're asking me for money?

Act5-2#4.zh: 少说闲话！留下银子，放你过去；若说半个不字，教你认得俺们！
Act5-2#4.t: Enough talk! Leave the silver and you can pass. Say one word of no and you'll learn who we are!

Act5-2#5.zh: 这几个鸟人，倒来寻鲁大哥的晦气！
Act5-2#5.t: These scum are picking a fight with Brother Lu!

Act5-2#6.zh: 兄弟们且站开，休来插手！只这几个腌臜泼才，洒家一个便料理了！
Act5-2#6.t: Stand back, brothers, don't interfere! I can handle these filthy louts by myself!

Act5-2#7.zh: 好，我们就在旁边，看大哥的手段！
Act5-2#7.t: Right, we'll stay over here and watch you work, brother!

Act5-2#8.zh: 五回合内打倒四名泼皮；鲁智深倒下或超时则失败。其余好汉旁观，不参加战斗。
Act5-2#8.t: Knock down the four thugs within five turns. Defeat if Lu Zhishen falls or time runs out. The other heroes watch and don't fight.

Act5-2#9.zh: 方才那股横劲哪里去了？尽管上来，休教洒家一个个寻你！
Act5-2#9.t: Where's that swagger now? Come on, don't make me hunt you down one by one!

Act5-2#10.zh: 四个泼皮被打得东倒西歪，连声告饶，哪里还敢逞强。
Act5-2#10.t: The four thugs were knocked every which way and begged for mercy, all their bluster gone.

Act5-2#11.zh: 有手有脚，不去寻个正经营生，却在街头欺人！往后再教洒家撞见，可没今日这般便宜！
Act5-2#11.t: You've got hands and feet. Instead of finding honest work you bully people in the street! If I catch you again, you won't get off this lightly!

Act5-2#12.zh: 大哥还未使禅杖，他们便撑不住了。
Act5-2#12.t: You didn't even use your staff, brother, and they couldn't take it.

Act5-2#13.zh: 说起气力，且教你们看个明白。
Act5-2#13.t: Speaking of strength, let me show you something.

Act5-2#14.zh: 智深走到柳树旁，束紧腰间衣带，两手抱住树身，腰胯间猛一发力！
Act5-2#14.t: Zhishen walked to a willow, tightened his sash, wrapped both arms around the trunk and heaved with all his might!

Act5-2#15.zh: 只听土响根摧，一株垂杨柳竟被他连根拔起。泼皮们看得目瞪口呆，拜服散去。
Act5-2#15.t: The earth cracked and the roots tore, and the weeping willow came out roots and all. The thugs stared open-mouthed, bowed in awe and scattered.

Act5-2#16.zh: 鲁大哥这番手段，今日可开了眼！
Act5-2#16.t: Brother Lu, that was something to see!

Act5-2#17.zh: 拔树算甚么！待洒家再使一路禅杖与你们看。
Act5-2#17.t: Pulling up a tree is nothing! Now I'll show you a round with the staff.

Act5-2#19.zh: 哪位官人在那里喝彩？既看得入眼，何不过来相叙？
Act5-2#19.t: Who's cheering over there? If you like what you see, why not come and join us?

Act5-2#20.zh: 这条禅杖少说也有六十来斤，师兄使来却似浑不费力，教人好生钦佩！
Act5-2#20.t: That staff must weigh sixty catties at least, yet you wield it without effort, brother. I'm truly impressed!

Act5-2#21.zh: 洒家关西鲁达，如今法名智深。未敢请教官人姓名？
Act5-2#21.t: I'm Lu Da of Guanxi, now called Zhishen in religion. May I ask your name, sir?

Act5-2#22.zh: 在下林冲，在东京充个禁军枪棒教头。
Act5-2#22.t: I am Lin Chong, arms instructor of the Imperial Guard here in Kaifeng.

Act5-2#23.zh: 莫不是林提辖的公子？洒家在东京，正愁少个相知的弟兄！
Act5-2#23.t: Not the son of Major Lin? Here in Kaifeng I was just missing a brother I could talk to!

Act5-2#24.zh: 二人越说越投契，林冲拜智深为兄。众人就在酒铺前坐下，彼此叙礼。
Act5-2#24.t: The more they talked, the better they got on, and Lin Chong took Zhishen as his elder brother. Everyone sat down in front of the wine shop and exchanged greetings.

Act5-2#25.zh: 林教头，在下是王进王教头的徒弟，吾师有一信要转交给你。
Act5-2#25.t: Instructor Lin, I'm a student of Instructor Wang Jin. My master asked me to give you this letter.

Act5-2#26.zh: 哦？我看看……王兄的好意，林冲心领了。只是在东京尚有家眷，不能说走便走。
Act5-2#26.t: Oh? Let me see... I'm grateful for Brother Wang's kindness. But I have family here in Kaifeng; I can't just up and leave.

Act5-2#27.zh: 教头今日怎地恰从这里经过？
Act5-2#27.t: How is it you happened to pass by here today, Instructor?

Act5-2#28.zh: 今日陪拙荆到庙里还愿，见师兄舞杖看得入神，便让她与丫头先去烧香了。
Act5-2#28.t: I brought my wife to the temple to fulfil a vow. Seeing you with the staff, I was so taken that I let her and the maid go burn incense first.

Act5-2#29.zh: 放着夫人独自去上香，不要紧么？
Act5-2#29.t: Is it all right to let your wife go off to the incense alone?

Act5-2#30.zh: 就在近处，料也无妨。来，诸位且饮一杯。
Act5-2#30.t: It's close by; it should be fine. Come, everyone, have a cup.

Act5-2#31.zh: 官人！不要再喝酒了！夫人在庙前被一群登徒子纠缠住了！
Act5-2#31.t: Master! No more drinking! The mistress is being pestered by a gang of rakes in front of the temple!

Act5-2#33.zh: 方才经过五岳楼，几个富家子弟拦住夫人。我看情势不妙，便脱身来寻官人！
Act5-2#33.t: Just now at the Five Peaks Tower, some rich young men stopped her. It looked bad, so I slipped away to find you, master!

Act5-2#34.zh: 锦儿，快带路！诸位，林冲先行一步！
Act5-2#34.t: Jin'er, lead the way, quickly! Everyone, I must go ahead!

Act5-2#35.zh: 林教头有麻烦，我们去帮他！
Act5-2#35.t: Instructor Lin is in trouble. Let's go help him!

Act5-2#36.zh: 好！休教那伙鸟人欺了他的家眷！
Act5-2#36.t: Right! We won't let those scum bully his family!

Act5-2#37.zh: 柳下识英雄，舞杖逢知己。众人急往岳庙，接应林教头。
Act5-2#37.t: A hero met beneath the willow, a friend found through the staff. Everyone hurries to the Yue Temple to back up Instructor Lin.

Act5-2#38.zh: 鲁智深倒下，众人只得上前救护，未能独自打退泼皮。
Act5-2#38.t: Lu Zhishen fell, and the others had to step in to save him. He couldn't drive off the thugs alone.
